name: TC-100: a placed order is received on the POS and driven through the full lifecycle
description: A customer order (seeded via the public order API at its real menu price, bumped to PENDING — no Stripe) appears in the restaurant's live current-orders feed, and can be driven PENDING → CONFIRMED → PREPARING → READY → PICKED_UP with each transition confirmed at the API source of truth.
